name: Qualified bidders
statement: A registered agent identity is a member while an accepted issuer asserts delivery capability of level 2 or higher for it, and its current controller shows two accepted task deliveries made within the last ninety days.

subjects.note: The credential and the history are both tied to the controller. A new controller qualifies on its own evidence.
